title: Spinach and Shrimp Dip
description: This is a simple, but tasty variation on a cocktail-party classic.
ingredients: One 10-ounce package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
3/4 pound cooked, peeled, deveined shrimp, coarsely chopped
directions: In a food processor, pulse the cilantro, scallions, garlic and jalapeño until finely chopped.
Add the spinach, mayonnaise, cream cheese, lime juice and salt to taste and process until smooth.
Add the coarsely chopped shrimp and pulse until mixed and chopped a little more.
Transfer the dip to a bowl and refrigerate until chilled before serving.
